sources.section: 3.9.2 Metallic-Roughness Material; 5.22 Material PBR Metallic Roughness (baseColorTexture, metallicRoughnessTexture)
sources.facts: Base colour: RGB encoded with the sRGB transfer function; the fourth component (A), when present, is the linear alpha coverage. Metallic-roughness: metalness sampled from B, roughness from G, linear transfer function; R and A are ignored for metallic-roughness calculations.

sources.section: 3.9.3 Additional Textures (Normal Texture, Occlusion Texture); 5.19 Material (normalTexture, occlusionTexture, emissiveTexture)
sources.facts: Normal: tangent-space XYZ as RGB with the linear transfer function, the convention +X right and +Y up, +Z toward the viewer, A ignored. Occlusion: linearly sampled from R, higher values receive full indirect lighting, G, B and A ignored. Emissive: RGB encoded with the sRGB transfer function, A ignored.
The alpha value of the metallic-roughness material model is taken from the fourth component of the base colour.

sources.section: 2.6 File Extensions and Media Types; 3.8.3 Images
sources.facts: Core images are image/png or image/jpeg; JPEG has one or three 8-bit components (no alpha); colour-space information in PNG or JPEG files is ignored, so the transfer function is the one the referring glTF property defines.

sources.page: UzPainter decision 023 (owner answer Q10); docs/architecture/08-export.md section 4
sources.facts: SpecularWeight is exported and reported in the export receipt as a consumer gap wherever the consumer has no binding for it; omitting it silently was rejected.

packing.decision: RGB from documentMap basecolor, A from documentMap opacity (dropped when the stack has no opacity channel, probe P7); the colour is written in its channel's encoding (an sRGB8 BaseColor sRGB-encoded, decision 126)
packing.source: glTF 2.0 section 3.9.2 and section 5.22 baseColorTexture (sRGB RGB, linear alpha coverage in A); section 3.9.4 Alpha Coverage

packing.decision: R from virtualMap AO_Mixed, G from documentMap roughness, B from documentMap metallic, linear; AO_Mixed remains refused until fitted
packing.source: glTF 2.0 sections 3.9.2, 3.9.3, 5.19 and 5.22 allow occlusion R and metallic-roughness G/B in one texture; independently authored combination confirmed by R-314 on authored fixtures
glTF 2.0 section 3.9.3 Normal Texture and section 5.19 normalTexture (tangent space, +X right and +Y up: the OpenGL convention; linear)

packing.decision: RGB from documentMap emissive, written in its channel's encoding
packing.source: glTF 2.0 section 5.19 emissiveTexture (sRGB RGB, A ignored)

packing.decision: UzPainter extension: L from documentMap specularweight, written when present and reported as a consumer gap. Its authored defaults are PNG8 without dithering, overridable by pipeline parameters. Painter glTF exports no such file; this is not a Painter parity claim.
packing.source: decision 023; glTF 2.0 section 3.9.2 (the core metallic-roughness material has no specular input); decision 314

packing.decision: Four compatibility maps use PNG 8; normal enables dithering, other three disable it. Pipeline parameters override map defaults (R-314 exports PNG16 without dithering). Required padding has no preset default: the own-parameters probe raises ValueError. Supplemental SpecularWeight uses the separately defined UzPainter defaults. No Height map. Correct URL is export-preset-generator://gltf; starter-assets URL is undefined. glTF/GLB scene generation is not provided by this texture preset. Padding-only follow-up confirms all four PNG8 files, stable across save/reopen in Legacy and OCIO.
packing.source: glTF 2.0 sections 2.6, 3.8.3 and 3.9; R-314 behavioural confirmation on authored fixtures; decision 023 for supplemental SpecularWeight

pending.what: Layout and predefined URL confirmed by R-314 Legacy/OCIO r1/r2. Full decoded texture parity remains pending (AO_Mixed, infinite/islandnormal padding, dithering and real pilot acceptance); own-parameter exports require explicit padding. SpecularWeight is a deliberate UzPainter extension with no Painter counterpart. The texture preset does not generate Painter glTF/GLB scene sidecars.
